# Report Card — Tree menu map generator

> Source: `features/treemenu.feature` · printable rendering · regenerate with `python3 print-card.py`

**Intent:** As a Paketti maintainer, I want Lua menu registrations rendered as a grouped tree, So that menu organization can be inspected without manually grepping thousands of add_menu_entry calls.

**Grades:** @code-verified × 7 · @runtime-untested × 7 · @shipped × 7

**Scenarios: 7**


---


## 1. Literal menu registrations become an exact static tree

`@shipped @code-verified @runtime-untested`


- Given Lua files contain PakettiAddMenuEntry or renoise.tool():add_menu_entry calls with literal name fields
- When the maintainer runs "./treemenu"
- Then "menu_items.txt" contains an "Exact Static Tree" grouped by colon-separated Renoise menu branch
- And the tree uses visible "|____" depth prefixes for nested branches
- And each leaf prints the full "Root:Folder:Entry" Renoise menu path
- And each leaf cites the source file, line number, and registration API on the same row as the menu path

<sub>cite: treemenu extract_entries · treemenu build_report · treemenu format_tree</sub>


## 2. Separator markers group under the real menu root

`@shipped @code-verified @runtime-untested`


- Given a menu entry name begins with Renoise's "--" separator marker
- When the tree is generated
- Then the leading marker is stripped before branch grouping
- And the source line is marked with "[separator]"

<sub>cite: treemenu clean_menu_path</sub>


## 3. Dynamic paths are visible without polluting the exact tree

`@shipped @code-verified @runtime-untested`


- Given a menu entry name contains variables or non-static expressions
- When the tree is generated
- Then that registration is listed under "Dynamic / partial registrations"
- And it is excluded from the exact static tree

<sub>cite: treemenu resolve_name_expr · treemenu build_report</sub>


## 4. Simple Lua loops expand into concrete menu rows

`@shipped @code-verified @runtime-untested`


- Given a menu entry name is generated by a simple numeric for-loop, string.format call, or ipairs loop over literal strings or record tables
- When the tree is generated
- Then each generated menu name appears as a concrete exact tree row
- And the source expression is not repeated as an unresolved dynamic entry

<sub>cite: treemenu expand_name_expr · treemenu numeric_loop_values · treemenu table_loop_values · treemenu table_loop_records</sub>


## 5. One root branch can be inspected alone

`@shipped @code-verified @runtime-untested`


- Given the maintainer wants to focus on one Renoise menu context
- When they run "./treemenu --branch 'Sample Editor' --output /tmp/sample-editor-menu.txt"
- Then the output contains only registrations below the "Sample Editor" root branch

<sub>cite: treemenu main</sub>


## 6. The report can refresh repeatedly while source files are edited

`@shipped @code-verified @runtime-untested`


- Given the maintainer is editing Lua menu-registration source files
- When they run "./runner treemenu"
- Then treemenu runs repeatedly until interrupted
- And each new run starts after the previous run finishes and the configured delay elapses
- And the default delay is 5 seconds

<sub>cite: runner</sub>


## 7. Duplicate exact menu paths expose real registration bugs

`@shipped @code-verified @runtime-untested`


- Given two active menu-entry definitions use the same exact Renoise menu path
- When treemenu generates the duplicate exact menu path section
- Then the duplicated path is visible with every source location
- And the source should be deduplicated rather than treated as valid runtime output

<sub>cite: treemenu format_duplicates · PakettiMenuConfig.lua Paketti Pattern / Phrase Init Preferences menu registration</sub>
